notes.title: 🌾 Super Farming Boy – Massive Update Before Launch! 🌾
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Super Farmers!
We’ve got a ton of juicy updates coming your way ahead of [b]Super Farming Boy’s Early Access launch on August 12th[/b]! 🚜💥[/p][p]First of all—[b]thank you SO MUCH[/b] to all the beta testers and content creators who’ve been playing the game and sending amazing feedback. You've helped us level up in so many ways![/p][p][/p][h2]🛠️ Patch Highlights – What’s New & Fixed:[/h2][p][/p][h3]🎁 Secret Codes Galore![/h3][p]Influencer gift codes are now working!
If you're a content creator and signed up for this feature, you’ll be hearing from us very soon![/p][p][/p][h3]🏊 Pool Exit Button[/h3][p]We’ve added an on-screen hint to show how to exit the stamina pool.[/p][p][/p][h3]📖 Encyclopedia & Shop Cards[/h3][list][*][p]Veggie combo hits now display correctly in the Encyclopedia and shop![/p][/*][*][p]All crop cards now state whether they grow once or regrow.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🎮 Steam Deck Tweaks[/h3][list][*][p]Camera is now closer (no more squinting!)[/p][/*][*][p]Various Steam Deck-specific improvements[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]🌳 Apple Tree Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Apple trees no longer disappear during storms[/p][/*][*][p]Apples won’t destroy specialty seeds anymore (e.g., Daylight Seeds)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]🌋 Volcanic Zone Rebalance[/h3][list][*][p]More coin rewards[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified combo pattern for Cauliflower[/p][/*][*][p]Watering Seed pattern also more predictable[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]🏠 Entering Buildings Bug[/h3][p]Fixed the issue where entering a building would sometimes throw you right back out.[/p][p][/p][h3]👻 Ghoul Behavior[/h3][p]Ghouls no longer "wait" for you when transitioning between areas—no more unfair fainting![/p][p][/p][h3]📚 Encyclopedia "NEW" Tag[/h3][p]No more false alarms—the “NEW” tag only appears when something is truly new.[/p][p][/p][h3]🧾 Korpo Bill Sprites[/h3][p]Shell icons and other assets on bill were incorrect—now fixed.[/p][p][/p][h3]🛰️ Space Gazette Missions[/h3][p]Most missions now yield more reward.[/p][p][/p][h3]🏆 Steam Achievements[/h3][p]Steam Achievements are now active and working![/p][p][/p][h3]🌦️ Season Change Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Some crops no longer wither immediately when seasons change[/p][/*][*][p]Withered crops now have a 50% chance to spawn diamonds when picked[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]🐶 Toto at Night[/h3][p]Toto's nighttime visual glitches are now, finally, resolved.[/p][p][/p][h3]⭐ Fever Stars Bug[/h3][p]Fever Stars now fly properly to your Fever Gauge—no more getting stuck! (used to happen a lot with apple trees)[/p][p][/p][h3]🗣️ NPC Interactions[/h3][p]You can now talk to NPCs by clicking/interacting anywhere on their body, not just their feet. Way smoother![/p][p][/p][h3]🌿 Repliplants & Apple Trees[/h3][p]These now correctly survive through season changes, as originally intended.[/p][p][/p][h3]🔊 Sound Settings[/h3][list][*][p]Volume settings are now saved between sessions[/p][/*][*][p]Tons of sound design improvements by our sound wizard, Toni Leys![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🌟 More Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Special crops no longer get destroyed by falling apples[/p][/*][*][p]Missing combo info on inspecting some seeds & Big Crops now displays correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Millions of tiny tweaks to balance and economics![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]🐞 Known Issues:[/h2][list][*][p]Apples falling directly from the tree don’t damage crop eaters—but bounced ones do[/p][/*][*][p]Occasionally no SkullRocks spawn from overkilling crop eaters[/p][/*][*][p]Rare collider glitches let you walk anywhere—usually self-corrects quickly[/p][/*][*][p]Some Specialty Seeds are missing from the Encyclopedia[/p][/*][*][p]A few Space Gazette missions are not working or described correctly[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]🔮 Coming Soon:[/h2][p]We're hard at work on some BIG new features:[/p][list][*][p]🪰 More pests! (FLIES and SPIDERS incoming!)[/p][/*][*][p]👹 A Boss Fight![/p][/*][*][p]🌊 New Seasons: Underwater & Timewarp[/p][/*][*][p]🍄 Magic Mushrooms! (Wild effects based on how you eat & combine them—think [i]Binding of Isaac[/i])[/p][/*][*][p]📋 More To-Do Lists to keep you busy[/p][/*][*][p]🚀 More missions in The Space Gazette[/p][/*][*][p]🕵️ ...and a bunch of secret stuff![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for being with us since day one. Your feedback is shaping Super Farming Boy into something truly special, and we can’t wait to keep growing it with you![/p][p]💚
— The LemonChili Team[/p]
